name: logseq-flashcard-favorite
description: Generate and keep in sync the [[Logseq/Flashcard/Review/Favorite]] deck tree from the graph's :favorites (logseq/config.edn). Use when the user asks to build, refresh, or reconcile favorite-driven flashcard decks: an aggregate {{cards (or …)}} deck, a negated background {{cards (not (or …))}} deck, and one scoped {{cards [[Favorite]]}} subpage per favorite. Runs idempotently via the mise file task and preserves the review-history children Logseq appends to {{cards}} blocks. Do not use for ad-hoc card authoring (logseq-flashcard) or non-favorite decks.
